subject.title: fix(agents): thinking-enabled Anthropic sessions fail with "Invalid signature" after tool loops

question: Should OpenClaw adopt current-turn-only signed-thinking replay as the default for all thinking-enabled native Anthropic sessions?
rationale: Anthropic permits prior-turn omission, but newer models intentionally retain prior thinking for context and caching; deciding that global availability-versus-continuity tradeoff requires maintainer intent rather than another mechanical code change.

options.title: Adopt current-turn replay
options.body: Land the symmetric policy and accept completed-turn reasoning and cache loss as the default resilience tradeoff.

options.title: Require provenance-aware preservation
options.body: Pause this PR and retain historical thinking only when its signed context can be trusted, with rejection recovery as fallback.

recommendation.title: Adopt current-turn replay
recommendation.body: Land the symmetric policy and accept completed-turn reasoning and cache loss as the default resilience tradeoff.
